title: - Senior HR Business Partner
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

  

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

  

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About the Role
  

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded 
**Senior HR Business Partner**
 to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.

  

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.

  

With teams across the 
**UK, Portugal and Brazil**
, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.

  

You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.

  
What You’ll Do
  
Partner with Senior Leadership
  

  
* Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.
  
* Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.
  
* Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  
  

  
Drive People Strategy & Transformation
  

  
* Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.
  
* Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.
  
  

  
Lead Core HR Processes
  

  
* Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.
  
* Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.
  
* Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.
  
* Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.
  
  

  
Use Data to Drive Decisions
  

  
* Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
  
* Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
* Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.
  
  

  
Coach & Develop Leaders
  

  
* Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.
  
* Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.
  
  

  
Collaborate Across People & Culture
  

  
* Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.
  
* Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.
  
  

  
What We’re Looking For
  

You’ll bring:

  

  
* Proven experience in an 
  **HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role**
  , ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.
  
* A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
* A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.
  
* Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.
  
* Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.
  
* Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.
  
* A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.
  
* Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  
* The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.
  
* A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.
  
  

  
Nice to Have
  

  
* Experience working within a 
  **technology, startup or high-growth environment**
  .
  
* Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.
  
* Knowledge of 
  **Portuguese**
   would be an advantage.

  
  

Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 

  

We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Go-To-Market)
description:
**About Us**
At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.
  
  
As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.
  
  
Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together.
**Our values**
guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.
  
  
As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.
  
  
Learn more at
**Sitecore.com**
.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Human Resources Business Partner to support our EMEA and global leaders.
  
  
This role provides strategic and operational HR partnership to senior leaders, helping drive organisational effectiveness, talent outcomes and employee engagement. The successful candidate will be a trusted adviser, capable of navigating complex people challenges while balancing business priorities, employee experience and risk.
  
  
A key focus is providing expert guidance on Employee Relations matters, including complex performance, conduct, investigations, organisational change and employee exits across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Partner with senior leaders to align people strategies with business priorities and organisational goals
* Provide expert advice and leadership on complex Employee Relations matters, ensuring balanced, practical and compliant outcomes
* Coach leaders to build strong management capability and foster a high-performance culture
* Support organisational design, workforce planning, talent development and succession planning
* Lead and support organisational change, using people data and insights to inform decisions and mitigate risk
* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, Reward, People Operations and Employment Legal to deliver a consistent employee experience.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Significant HR Business Partner experience in a fast-paced, SaaS or Tech GTM, international environment, with demonstrated success operating at Senior HRBP level
* Deep Employee Relations expertise, including complex investigations, performance management, organisational change and employee exits
* Knowledge of UK, EMEA, and International employment law and experience supporting international teams
* Demonstrable experience of communicating and educating leaders on job architecture and compensation models
* Experience supporting sales, services, or customer-facing organisations
* Strong coaching, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with a commercial mindset and sound judgement

**What Success Looks Like**
You are a credible and pragmatic HR leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You build trusted partnerships, confidently manage complex people matters and help leaders create high-performing, engaged teams while navigating change effectively.
  
  
**Equal Opportunities At Sitecore**
Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.
